description: This file contains functions and type definitions for handling provider authentication choices, including plugin provider loading, applying authentication methods, and managing configuration states within a plugin-based architecture.

methods.name: restoreConfiguredPrimaryModel
methods.description: Restores the primary model in the configuration to its original setting if it was changed.

methods.name: loadPluginProviderRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the plugin provider runtime module.

methods.name: runProviderPluginAuthMethod
methods.description: Executes a provider authentication method, updates configuration, and manages profiles and notes.

methods.name: applyAuthChoiceLoadedPluginProvider
methods.description: Loads plugin providers, resolves the chosen provider, and applies authentication, optionally setting default models.

methods.name: applyAuthChoicePluginProvider
methods.description: Enables a plugin provider, resolves the provider and method, and applies authentication, optionally setting default models.
